authoritativeDefinitions.semanticLayer: Governed vocabulary and metric definitions; never a substitute for source authority.
authoritativeDefinitions.dataContract: Producer/consumer contract covering schema, provenance, quality, freshness, units, CRS/datum and compatibility.
authoritativeDefinitions.businessGlossary: Controlled definitions for agency-facing concepts and lifecycle states.
authoritativeDefinitions.masterDataGovernance: Identity, stewardship, ownership and lifecycle controls for shared reference entities.
authoritativeDefinitions.architectureRepository: Version-controlled machine-readable architecture contracts, schemas, migrations and diagrams.

rules: Authoritative source identity is explicit and never inferred from presentation output.
Every promoted data product has an owner/steward, schema version and provenance contract.
Logical and physical models remain separately versioned.
Connected streaming cannot activate Sovereign Mode.
Architecture terms describe enforceable repository artifacts, not merely documentation.
